semantics: Append-only in shape: each record states one product's current bench verdict as published in the Bazaar catalog. A verdict is withdrawn or replaced ONLY by a superseding record for the same product (a later record with status 'superseded' pointing at its replacement, or a record with verdict 'WITHDRAWN'); consumers should take the latest record per product as current. Records are never silently edited — corrections arrive as new records. This file is regenerated from catalog.json + the hosted scorecards at /cards/ and always represents current state.
